# 0002. The app project is generated by xcodegen

- Status: accepted
- Date: 2026-10-13

## Context and Problem Statement

The app needs a real bundle, entitlements, an `Info.plist`, and a stable code-signing identity so macOS keeps privacy grants
across rebuilds. The project file must not cause merge conflicts in a chain of stacked pull requests.

## Considered Options

- A hand-maintained `.xcodeproj`.
- A Swift package executable.
- An `.xcodeproj` generated from a YAML spec by xcodegen.

## Decision Outcome

`App/project.yml` is the source of truth. `make bootstrap` runs xcodegen to produce `App/Susurro.xcodeproj`, which is
gitignored. Signing identity and team come from a gitignored `App/Config/Local.xcconfig` layered over a committed
`Base.xcconfig` that signs ad hoc, so fresh clones and CI build without credentials.

### Consequences

- Good: a reviewable YAML diff, no project-file conflicts, and a bundle that can hold entitlements and a stable identity.
- Bad: xcodegen is a build-time tool every contributor and the CI image need.
- Bad: ad-hoc signing disables the hardened runtime. Release builds must use a real identity.
